model.name: LTX-2.3 Distilled GGUF Q6_K Light 22B (Low VRAM / Compatibility)
model.description: Low-VRAM and compatibility alternative for the LTX-2.3 distilled 22B family. It uses about 1.2 GiB less VRAM than the installed INT8 variant in the local RTX 4090 comparison, but is slower on Linux without a compatible fused GGUF CUDA kernel. Prefer Distilled INT8 when memory allows.
